text:
maria.s: sec-bot alert: KMS Decrypt denied for `cert-rotator` service-account in ap-southeast-1 canary  :rotating_light:
sec-bot: alert details -> project=redwood-prod region=ap-southeast-1 service=cert-rotator action=KMS.Decrypt resource=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/rotator-key status=DENIED
raj.i: seeing the same in logs, grabbing recent kube events and the pod logs now
raj.i: `kubectl -n infra get events --field-selector involvedObject.name=cert-rotator-canary` shows `Failed to decrypt: access denied` repeated ~6 times
olivia.sre: we pushed an RBAC tweak for KMS roles to the infra bootstrap last night (PR #582). Can someone check the exact change?
diana.prodeng: pinging infra-iam owners: @raj.i any chance the PR added a deny/removed binding for `sa:cert-rotator@redwood-prod`?
raj.i: scanning the terraform state: found this policy block removed the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` binding for the cert-rotator SA in ap-southeast-1 by mistake. I have the diff.
raj.i: patch proposal: re-add binding scoped to the single key resource, not project-wide. quick terraform snippet:
```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "rotator-decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/certs/cryptoKeys/rotator-key"
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```
olivia.sre: agree, re-adding scoped binding is fine. But we need an emergency fallback while TF apply runs — cert-rotator should be able to serve cached certs for a few minutes. Set the deployment annotation to enable cache-fallback: `kubectl -n infra patch deploy cert-rotator --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"rotator.redwood/cache-fallback":"true"}}}}}'`
oncall-sre: do we have a playbook to rollback that last IAM change? If not, we'll apply the above snippet manually and run `gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding` as a temporary fix.
diana.prodeng: also noticed Cloud Audit Logs for `serviceAccount:cert-rotator@redwood-prod` are missing between 01:12-01:22 UTC in ap-southeast-1. Could be an ingestion gap or suppressed logs due to the deny. Query I used:
```bash
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="prod-canary" AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail="cert-rotator@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"' --freshness=1h --limit=50
```
maria.s: priority P0: restore decrypt so cert rotation resumes, enable fallback, and confirm audit logs. Raj, can you cold patch the IAM binding and follow up when done?
raj.i: starting manual add-iam-policy-binding now with least-priv scope. Will report back in ~5m.
sec-bot: vulnerability scan flagged openssl config on rotator image: TLSv1/SSLv3 fallback enabled in /etc/ssl/openssl.cnf -> CVSS 6.5 advisory. Not causing current decrypt failures but we should harden TLS config in next image build.
oncall-sre: noted. For immediate incident we keep current image, schedule a rebuild for tomorrow. Requesting owners for CVE triage: @olivia.sre to coordinate image rebuild, @diana.prodeng to own audit and postmortem notes.
olivia.sre: I'll add a job to the pipeline to bump openssl and remove insecure protocols, test in staging.
diana.prodeng: creating an incident doc skeleton and will add timeline + missing audit evidence section (we need to capture logs before TF apply).
raj.i: IAM binding applied, ran `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and verified `cert-rotator` SA now has decrypt. Confirmed one successful Decrypt in logs at 01:16:42 UTC.
maria.s: great, can we see the rotator pod resume?
raj.i: cert-rotator canary pod restarted by healthcheck and now shows `rotation: success` in logs. pushing TF fix to main with the scoped binding, will follow with PR link.
maria.s: follow ups: (1) audit log gap root cause (2) add alert for KMS DENIED spikes (3) patch openssl in image (4) add a preapply check in infra CI to detect removal of KMS bindings
diana.prodeng: assigning actions in the incident doc. Will circle back with a timeline and RCA. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: incident closed -> automated verify checks passed after IAM restore and canary rotation succeeded
olivia.sre: thanks team, marking as mitigation complete and scheduling hardening work for next sprint. :white_check_mark:
